services.name: Private Bay Cruise on Luxury Boat
services.desc: Looking for a day in the sun, or just want to get on the water in San Diego? Welcome aboard the Nimbus. Your private party can enjoy cruising around Mission Bay in style and comfort. Perfect for special occasions and memorable moments. The Nimbus is 37 feet of space equipped with plenty of cushioned seating, a private head (restroom), a killer Sirius sound system, and a stable ride at both slow and (very!) fast speeds. We provide light snacks, water, and Gatorade. You are welcome to bring a picnic lunch and any beverages you desire... just no glass.
